python3 <<'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
BJ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
start = datetime(2026,9,11,0,0,0,tzinfo=BJ)
end = datetime(2026,9,12,0,0,0,tzinfo=BJ)

# Full bus inbox items for today
inbox = os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl")
sent = os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/sent.json")
# also look for reply files
state_dir = os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state")
print("state files:", os.listdir(state_dir)[:40])

def parse_ts(obj):
    for k in ("ts","timestamp","created_at","time","received_at","sent_at"):
        v = obj.get(k) if isinstance(obj,dict) else None
        if v is None: continue
        if isinstance(v,(int,float)):
            if v > 1e12: v=v/1000.0
            return datetime.fromtimestamp(v, tz=timezone.utc).astimezone(BJ)
        s=str(v)
        try:
            dt=datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace('Z','+00:00'))
            if dt.tzinfo is None: dt=dt.replace(tzinfo=BJ)
            return dt.astimezone(BJ)
        except: pass
    return None

print("\n=== INBOX TODAY FULL TEXT ===")
with open(inbox,'r',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for line in f:
        try: obj=json.loads(line)
        except: continue
        dt=parse_ts(obj)
        if not dt or not (start<=dt<end): continue
        text=obj.get('text') or obj.get('body') or obj.get('message') or ''
        print(f"\n--- bus={obj.get('bus_id') or obj.get('id')} dt={dt} ---")
        print(str(text)[:2500])

# sent.json may be list or jsonl
print("\n=== SENT TODAY ===")
for name in ["sent.json","sent.jsonl","outbox.jsonl","youchu_ai_outbox.jsonl","replies.jsonl"]:
    p=os.path.join(state_dir,name)
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        continue
    print("file", name, "size", os.path.getsize(p))
    try:
        if name.endswith('.json') and not name.endswith('.jsonl'):
            data=json.load(open(p))
            items=data if isinstance(data,list) else data.get('items',data.get('messages',[]))
            if isinstance(data,dict) and not items:
                # maybe dict keyed
                for k,v in list(data.items())[:5]:
                    print("key sample", k, type(v))
                items = list(data.values()) if all(isinstance(v,dict) for v in data.values()) else []
        else:
            items=[json.loads(l) for l in open(p) if l.strip()]
    except Exception as e:
        print("parse err", e); continue
    n=0
    for obj in items:
        if not isinstance(obj,dict): continue
        dt=parse_ts(obj)
        text=str(obj.get('text') or obj.get('body') or obj.get('message') or '')
        bus=obj.get('bus_id') or obj.get('reply_to') or obj.get('reply_to_bus_id')
        # also filter by date in text / ts
        ok = dt and start<=dt<end
        if not ok and ('2026-09-11' in text or (bus in (8357,8372,'8357','8372'))):
            ok=True
        if not ok: continue
        n+=1
        print(f"dt={dt} bus={bus} kind={obj.get('kind')} text={text[:400]}")
    print("count", n, "for", name)
PY

# Find transcripts modified today and extract user/assistant summaries
python3 <<'PY'
import os, json, glob
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
BJ=timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
base="/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts"
start=datetime(2026,9,11,0,0,0,tzinfo=BJ).timestamp()
end=datetime(2026,9,12,0,0,0,tzinfo=BJ).timestamp()
files=[]
for root,_,names in os.walk(base):
  for n in names:
    if n.endswith('.jsonl'):
      p=os.path.join(root,n)
      m=os.path.getmtime(p)
      if start<=m<end:
        files.append((m,p))
files.sort(reverse=True)
print(f"transcripts mtime today: {len(files)}")
for m,p in files[:30]:
  print(datetime.fromtimestamp(m,BJ).strftime('%H:%M:%S'), os.path.relpath(p,base), os.path.getsize(p))

# Also include files that contain today's date in content even if mtime later? Focus on today's mtime first.
# Extract first user message + last assistant-ish from each
print("\n=== SUMMARIES ===")
for m,p in files:
  first_user=None
  users=[]
  with open(p,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
    for line in f:
      try: o=json.loads(line)
      except: continue
      role=o.get('role') or o.get('type') or ''
      # cursor format may vary
      text=''
      if isinstance(o.get('message'),dict):
        role=o['message'].get('role',role)
        content=o['message'].get('content')
        if isinstance(content,str): text=content
        elif isinstance(content,list):
          text=' '.join(c.get('text','') for c in content if isinstance(c,dict))
      else:
        text=o.get('text') or o.get('content') or ''
        if isinstance(text,list):
          text=' '.join(c.get('text','') if isinstance(c,dict) else str(c) for c in text)
      text=str(text).strip()
      if not text: continue
      if role in ('user','human') or o.get('type')=='user':
        users.append(text[:200].replace('\n',' '))
  if not users: continue
  # skip pure wake/heartbeat only if ONLY those
  interesting=[u for u in users if not u.startswith('【定时') and 'AGENT_LOOP_WAKE' not in u and 'heartbeat' not in u.lower()]
  label=interesting[0] if interesting else users[0][:120]
  print(f"\n-- {os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(p))} --")
  print("users:", len(users), "interesting:", len(interesting))
  for u in (interesting or users)[:5]:
    print(" U:", u[:220])
